note: 0.5 dev.35 (Lateralus, 7 November 2026). Infantry launcher rate of fire per squad. Soldiers carrying the same launcher share one weapon and each reloads on his own, so squad rate = 60 x carriers / reload (measured in the editor: 5 RPG-26 carriers at 7 s fire every 1.41 s). Disposables (weapon type 63): squad rate = 12.16 x carriers^(1/3) per minute (2 carriers 15.3, 3: 17.5, 4: 19.2, 5: 20.7, 6: 22.0, 8: 24.1; average 20.0 over the 38 armory squads). The runtime sets each squad's reload to 60 x carriers / rate from squad-reload.json (unit, weapon) and the unit card shows the same rate. Reusable launchers (type 62): reload 6 s (10 per minute) in dev14-contract.json; the three rows used only by 2-launcher squads (Bur 155, RPG-7V PG-7TB 162, RPG-7V OG-7V 632) 9.6 s (12.5 per minute for the squad). Not yet run in a game.
